resources.string:
This app merges three Android tag libraries, all in Kotlin, into one library (android/merged/library), and shows each sample in a tab of a CYLTabBarController built from a configuration file.

• TagView: kaedea/android-tagview (b546a5f), Apache License 2.0, transcribed to Kotlin. Copyright (c) kaedea.

• TagContainer: whilu/AndroidTagView (75a3bba), Apache License 2.0, transcribed to Kotlin. Copyright 2015 lujun.

• TagViewGroup: the public API of shellljx/TagViewGroup (befcd9b), reimplemented in Kotlin; no code copied (the original is GPL-3.0).

• The plus button (New) opens the TagViewGroup editor.

The tab bar: CYLTabBarController for Android, checked out by commit (android/merged/gradle.properties).
